name: Lost Isle
detailed_description:
You sailed to the Lost Isle to stake your claim of wealth and glory, but after a violent storm, you were thrown overboard and washed ashore with nothing but a small knife and a single candle to light up the road. Carve out of existence in an unforgiving environment disguised as a paradise. You are not the only survivor; everyone is after the same thing: staying alive.

Lost Isle is a game of ingenuity and sheer will to survive. Each experience is what you make of it. Every day is a new chance to rise to the top, and every death is an opportunity for sweet revenge.

Inspired by other incredible survival games that we all know and love, Lost Isle takes the open-world survival craft genre and adds a medieval fantasy twist that is sure to feel like a fresh and unique experience.

With high-quality dedicated servers supporting up to 200 players, on a fresh server wipe, your first PvP encounter might be on a beach against other dagger-wielding survivors. Throughout the lifetime of a server, alliances will form, bases will be built, and PvP might turn into organized group raiding. Always watch your back because that player you killed on your first encounter on the beach might just take their revenge…

Players aren’t the only thing on the island out to get you. The world is full of intelligent creatures and wildlife equipped with AI designed to deliver an immersive and rewarding combat experience. On the other hand, PvE ranges from hunting rabbits and elk for resources to fending off wolves and sharks to taking down formidable night beasts, skeletal warriors, and forest golems.

Experience a new kind of first-person melee thanks to the directional combat system, developed to reward players’ abilities to hit sweet spots such as headshots and deal extra damage to take down your enemies more effectively. Whether you prefer to play as a spell-slinging wizard, arrow-flinging archer, or classic sword-wielding knight, there are weapons and armor for each playstyle.

Lost Isle differentiates from other open-world survival games in that it stems from the lore that the land the players are trapped in exists in an alternate earth setting. Taking place during the medieval period, the island itself is the prison-tomb of a fallen god named Mauroth - whose cosmic energies flow through the earth itself, into every root and vein. As you explore, you will encounter flora and fauna, some familiar and others that do not grow in our world.

Ever-burning trees that have long been dead but have never really died. Mineral deposits are the result of Mauroth’s celestial tomb being thrust down to Earth with immense heat and force. Fibrous plants infused with mystical properties. Flying beasts with skin so thick that almost nothing can pierce it. Endlessly wandering giants made from an amalgamation of all of these things. Harvesting these resources will allow you to craft the most powerful weapons and armor in the game.

Almost everything in Lost Isle is designed to be generated procedurally, from the biome and landscape generation to point-of-interest locations to the stats and effects of weapons and armor. We pride ourselves in saying that each wipe cycle you play will be a fresh experience and will never feel like you are repeating the same steps as your last adventure.

short_description: Explore a new take on open-world survival in a unique and procedural fantasy world. Build your own settlement and protect it from monstrous beasts and players alike. Craft weapons and equipment from a land bathed in cosmic power.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 | 64-bit OS
  • Processor: Intel I5 | 3.0GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 | AMD R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 | 64-bit OS
  • Processor: Intel i7 | 3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 | AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
